links.comparator_used: Alternative LLM explanation formats for the same output: standard output without explanation, differential diagnosis, and no LLM support
links.effect: Chain-of-thought was +12.2% vs no LLM support (P = 0.001), +7.2% vs standard output (P = 0.040), and +9.7% vs differential diagnosis format (P = 0.004)
links.quote: We find that the format of explanations significantly influences diagnostic accuracy.

links.comparator_used: Standard LLM output giving the diagnosis without explanation
links.effect: Chain-of-thought explanation improved accuracy by +7.2% over the standard output without explanation (P = 0.040), and by 12.2% over no LLM support (P = 0.001)
links.quote: Evidently, explaining the reasoning for a diagnosis helps physicians to identify and correct potential errors in LLM predictions and thus improve overall decisions.
